note: The journal's Living things list (src/world/journal/list.js, src/ui/journal.js): its groups, the filter and sort chips, and each thing's place. groups, in order: id, label, tint (a Web kind: journal.css --jw-<tint>-*), icon (its header's drawn icon), and which pages it holds: from (plants: words.order without animals; animals: the animals in words.order; finds: words.findOrder) and/or ids (named pages; a page named by a group is left out of a from group after it, and one that does not exist yet is skipped, so a group with nothing in it does not show). foundOnly: the group lists only what you have found, never what is still to find (finds), and hint is its pencil line before the first. unlock: the group stays out of the list until the island has given that (the saved unlocks, src/world/expansion.js; Shells come with the naturalist's first reward), unless something in it is already found. filters: the status chips (all, found, notYet) and the place chips. sorts: recent (most recently found first, the not yet seen last), az (by name), place (by place in the places order, then name). places: the place chips in order. placeOf: each page's place; a page with none takes its group's place. empty: the line a group shows when the chosen filter leaves nothing in it. Choices are kept per device (settings journalList) and never in an island file.

groups.label: Shells
groups.hint: Walk the strandline after a high tide; shells wash up where it turned.
